item.title: Daily Briefing - 2026-11-12
item.description:
**Morning Briefing**
**1) What Changed Since Yesterday** Markets showed slight volatility. Interest rates remain steady. Oil prices increased marginally.
**2) Venezuela Update** Negotiations between the government and opposition resumed. No concrete agreements announced. Humanitarian conditions remain critical.
**3) UK Response Signals** The UK government indicated support for a sanctions review against Venezuela. Discussions on energy security gains traction.
**4) Legal/Docket Watch** No new developments reported in the Epstein-related cases.
**5) What to Watch Today** Watch for the release of U.S. jobless claims data. Monitor ongoing negotiations in Venezuela for potential updates. Observe any responses from the UK on energy policy adjustments.
End of briefing.
